EASY TO DROWN - Elijah that screaming is lowkey orgasmic holy shit overall i really liked this one! i could totally listen to this while night driving yknow? the guitar part about 3/4ths of the way through is awesome 9/10 My Name - From Ashes To New me from two years ago would have EATEN this up. not as much anymore but i do quite like it. its one of those songs id jam out to really hard under specific moods. i really like the flow of it 7/10 Memories - Beyond Unbroken it kinda reminds me of my Get Scared phase (shoutout to you if you knew them). and just generally a lot of childhood songs and bands i was super into. nothing too much to say about it, i just generally really like it 8/10 Cold As Ice - Blacklite District it's a fun song tbh but its probably my least fav, not to trash on it though, i do like it and i really did like the little mixup thing it did like 70% of the way through (is it called a mixup?) 6/10 Overdose - Eddie and the Getaway this one actually surprised me a little. i wasnt sure how id feel about it at the start but i actually really like it! i couldnt tell you exactly why, but i just really like it a lot. 8.4/10!!!! Bulletproof - Godsmack this one is super catchy and the guitar feels really nostalgic to me. i think this one and EASY TO DROWN are definitely my favorites. i would definitely sing this in the shower (is that cringe to do nowadays? idk but i like doing it) 8.6/10
